items.title: Benkenstein's Bangladesh story comes full circle, 24 years on
items.summary: Dale Benkenstein's final international appearance came against Bangladesh in 2002, when he helped South Africa dismantle the Tigers with the ball in a 10-wicket win in Benoni. He never played another match in international colours after that.

items.summary: Batter experienced 'suicidal thoughts' after testing positive for ostarine during routine test in 2022

items.title: Bangladesh look to Robin to end leftie overload
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) yesterday announced its squad for the upcoming South Africa series, beginning on November 15. While there were a few notable changes, the spotlight fell on the inclusion of 22-year-old right-handed opener Mahfijul Islam Robin, who earned his maiden Test call-up.

items.title: Dale Benkenstein appointed Bangladesh's batting specialist ahead of SA tour
items.summary: Bangladesh are scheduled to tour South Africa in November and December 2026 to play two Tests, three ODIs and three T20Is

items.title: WTC dreams sacrificed at altar of poor planning
items.summary: The first two Tests of a crucial four-match stretch, which also includes two away Tests against South Africa, have exposed some of the worst planning failures in recent memory, leaving Bangladesh's WTC ambitions on shaky foundations.

items.title: Shanto: Bangladesh failed to make use of home conditions
items.summary: "Looking at the Test match as a whole, neither our batters nor our bowlers performed well; the responsibility lies with us"

items.title: Mumin breaks batting record, Tamim sets bowling mark as Bangladesh seal semifinal spot
items.summary: Middle-order batter Ahsan Al Mumin and pacer Tafiul Alam Tamim produced record-breaking performances to guide Bangladesh U-19 to a massive 205-run victory over Malaysia in their final Group B match at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground on Monday, sealing their place in the semifinals of the ongoing ACC U-19 Asia Cup.

items.title: Chase: Our improved game against spin helped us win in Bangladesh

items.title: Poor batting, spin bowling cost us series: Shanto
items.summary: It was undoubtedly a frustrating outcome for Shanto and his men, who struggled to maintain the momentum gained from their historic Test victory in Darwin in subsequent matches against Afghanistan and the West Indies.

items.title: Mushfiqur first Bangladesh batter to reach 7,000 Test runs
items.summary: Mushfiqur now sits comfortably atop Bangladesh’s all-time Test run charts, with a sizeable gap separating him from the rest of the country’s batting giants.
